berny1607.summary: A Brussels report on peace or a long truce, the cordelier’s assurances in Spain, and accusations that French interference and corruption are obstructing negotiations.
berny1607.en:
George Lasry, report PDF 50francais-3516-brulart-de-berny-f132r.pdf, "Excerpt and Translation".

No foundation other than a few reports reaching them from where you are, where there is undoubtedly much corruption. I shall not fail, if anything worthy arises…
